scenes.prompt: Tarun stands atop a concrete wall, gazing out over the city. He's dressed in his signature black tank top and dark grey joggers, his black combat boots planted firmly on the edge of the wall. His messy, spiky hair blows in the wind as he scans the rooftops, his eyes narrowed in concentration.

Tarun crouches in an alleyway, his eyes locked on a group of thugs harassing a street vendor. His lean, athletic build is tense, coiled like a spring, as he prepares to spring into action. His black tank top and dark grey joggers are stained with dirt and sweat, his black combat boots scuffed from countless battles.

Tarun stands in a dimly lit, abandoned warehouse, his eyes fixed on a rival fighter. The air is thick with tension as the two engage in a fierce stare-down, their bodies radiating hostility. Tarun's black tank top and dark grey joggers are a blur of motion as he moves, his black combat boots pounding the floor in a rhythmic beat.
